title: Arugula, Blueberry and Goat Cheese Salad
excerpt: A fresh, sophisticated salad that combines the slightly peppery touch of arugula, the creaminess of goat cheese and the natural sweetness of blueberries with a balsamic and honey vinaigrette.
imageAlt: Plate of fresh arugula salad with juicy blueberries, crumbled goat cheese and toasted walnuts in an elegant bowl.

ingredients.text: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

steps: In a small skillet over low heat, toast the nuts or almonds for 3 to 4 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden. Remove from the heat and let cool.
To make the vinaigrette, mix the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, lemon juice, a pinch of salt and pepper in a jar or small bowl. Whisk well until emulsified.
Place the fresh arugula as a base in a salad bowl or divide it among four individual plates.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, hand-picked in the high mountains of Guasca, whose sweetness contrasts perfectly with the intensity of the cheese and the greens.
Add the soft crumbled goat cheese and the toasted nuts on top.
Drizzle the vinaigrette right before serving to keep the leaves crisp, and toss gently.
tips: To keep your Fresh Pick blueberries in perfect condition, store them refrigerated in their original container and wash them only a few minutes before making your recipe.
If you want an even crunchier touch, you can lightly caramelize the nuts in the skillet with half a teaspoon of honey or grated panela before adding them to the salad.
